stories.headline: Raphaël Glucksmann wins the French Socialist presidential primary
stories.summary: The French Socialist Party, Place Publique and the Republican and Socialist Left ran an online primary from 9 to 11 October 2026. Raphaël Glucksmann won it in the first round with 66.13% of the vote, so the second round scheduled for 16–17 October was not needed. He will be their common candidate in the 2027 French presidential election.

stories.headline: Łukasz Gibała wins the Kraków mayoral election
stories.summary: Kraków, in Poland, held the second round of its mayoral election on 11 October 2026. Łukasz Gibała, an independent and a member of Kraków City Council, defeated Monika Piątkowska of the Civic Coalition by a margin of 62,878 votes. The seat had been vacant since the recall of Aleksander Miszalski on 24 May 2026.

stories.headline: Kentucky win a second overtime game by a single point
stories.summary: In American college football, the Kentucky Wildcats beat the LSU Tigers 35–34 in overtime at Kroger Field in Lexington. The game was settled by a 2-point conversion. Kentucky are the first team in FBS history to win consecutive overtime games by one point since overtime was introduced in 1996.

stories.headline: Two South American birds rival a chainsaw for loudness
stories.summary: The bare-throated bellbird and the red-legged seriema are two South American birds. Their calls can exceed 120 decibels, which puts them on par with a trumpeting elephant or a chainsaw. That makes them some of the loudest birds known.
